'''Jobal Rapier''' was a holo-entertainer. He was featured in the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] [[Life Debt (holodrama)|''Life Debt'']].

Jobal married [[Yari Cranna-Rapier]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], but the couple got separated two and a half years later, which, among other reasons, was admittedly done for press publicity.
